snapshot.title: Suspension of Operations — Hangar 1 and Horton Field

fields.headline: Formal Suspension of Hangar 1 Operations
fields.narration: This is the Incident Commander. I am issuing a formal suspension of all operations in Hangar 1 and the adjacent Horton Field flight zone. I am requesting that Harwick Police bring in a certified state-level counter-UAS team under the SAFER SKIES Act authority, as the drone has persisted for over 10 minutes and is flying over a crowd of 6,000. I confirm with Harwick Police that they will request the team via the state’s emergency coordination center (SEC-01). The Group will not interfere with the drone under any circumstances. All personnel must remain at their posts and await further instructions.
keyFacts: Harwick Police will request a state-level counter-UAS team via SEC-01.
All operations in Hangar 1 and Horton Field are suspended.
The Group will not interfere with the drone under any circumstances.
The drone has been over the fairgrounds crowd for over 10 minutes.
fields.expectedAction: The ASO updates the incident log (ERP-1001) with the decision to suspend operations, the request for a counter-UAS team, and the confirmation that the Group will not interfere with the drone, per HUOG-ERP Section 8.4. The Security liaison confirms the request to Harwick Police is underway.
fields.facilitatorNote: This inject confirms the escalation of law enforcement involvement. The ASO must record the suspension and team request in the incident log. The Security liaison must confirm the request to Harwick Police has been made.

snapshot.instructorNote: This inject confirms the formal escalation of law enforcement authority under the SAFER SKIES Act. The ASO must update ERP-1001 with the suspension and request. The Security liaison must confirm the request to Harwick Police is in progress. No Group action may be taken against the drone.
